problem:
Find the standard matrix that  represents  the  linear  transformation $T$, where

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}4x-y \\ 5x\end{aligned}].
$$

| $T=\,\,$ |  | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-3}} | {{field-4}} |  |  |
worked_solution:
We require a $2\times 2$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4\cdot x+(-1)\cdot y \\ 5\cdot x+0\cdot y\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4x-y \\ 5x\end{aligned}].
$$

    Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 5 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$
